section_3_location_lighting_pairs.pairing_policy: When a shot uses location_id, bind default_lighting_id from pairings unless narrative time explicitly advances.

usage_rules: Image App may bind location_id and lighting_id as reference keys only
Resolve location anchors from location-dna-library-v1 by location_id
Resolve lighting color bundle from lighting-dna-library-v1 by lighting_id
For same_place_sequence reuse identical location_id across consecutive shots
For same_time_sequence reuse identical lighting_id across consecutive shots
camera_view_variation allowed without changing location_id or lighting_id
do not generate scenarios or prompts from this adapter
do not merge or overwrite music-drama-image-adapter or living-world adapters

location_drift.policy: Bind location_id and reuse visual, architectural, and color anchors for same_place_sequence.

lighting_drift.policy: Bind lighting_id and reuse full color and contrast bundle for same_time_sequence.

scene_mutation.policy: Lock persistent_objects and architectural_anchors when location_id unchanged.

environment_consistency.policy: Align terrain_anchors and recommended_time_profiles with paired lighting time_period.
